violations.text: (Various food product) was observed held at (48-51) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling.PIC voluntarily disposed of food product. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2026
Inspector observed par cooked chicken in prep unit. PIC informed of proper procedures. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2026

Thermometers are lacking in the (reach in ) refrigeration unit(s). Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2026

Inspector observed a dead mouse on glue trap. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies.PIC removed from premises. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2026
Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2026

(1 Dr reach in ) located in the (kitchen ) area was not in good repair. Observed ambient temperatures at 50DF. Establishment not allowed to store TCS products in unit until repaired and/or replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2026
3 bay sink is lacking at bar area. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (mixer table and prep table shelves ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2026

The condensate from the (air conditioner and ice well ) refrigeration unit is draining into a container and hand sink. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2026
Chemicals were stored on the same shelf with food/equipment/single service articles in the (kitchen). Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/17/2025

Utensils in the kitchen area are displayed with the lip surface up. Utensils are to be stored so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self-service is provided. New Violation. Correct By: 02/17/2025
Menu is lacking allergen statement. English Food Allergy Reactions New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2024
Inspector observed prep sink lacking a barrier to prevent contamination from the mop sink. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2024
